graphs.title: Readme
graphs.markdown:
# DNS Threat Intelligence, C2 & Anomaly Intelligence | NeverOff V1

**Mission:** turn SentinelOne DNS telemetry into an analyst-focused hunting plane for DNS-based command-and-control, domain-generation behavior, tunneling/exfiltration candidates, anomalous resolution patterns, abuse-prone infrastructure, Threat Intelligence hits, and endpoint/process attribution.

## Native telemetry used
The dashboard is centered on `event.category == "dns"` and uses fields confirmed in the current SentinelOne field catalog:

- `event.dns.request` — requested domain.
- `event.dns.response` — DNS response data.
- `event.dns.responseCode` — numeric DNS response code.
- `event.dns.protocol` — DNS protocol value.
- `event.dns.transportProtocol` — DNS transport protocol.
- `event.dns.provider` — telemetry provider.
- `src.process.dnsCount` — DNS request count associated with the source process.
- `endpoint.name`, `endpoint.os`, `site.name`, `src.process.name`, `src.process.user`.

The dashboard also uses common SentinelOne process context such as `src.process.cmdline`, `src.process.image.path`, and `src.process.storyline.id` in investigation views. Validate population in the target tenant before production rollout.

## Threat Intelligence context
The **Threat Intelligence** tab consumes native `threat_intelligence_indicators` events and the current TI fields already used in SentinelOne dashboard content:
`tiIndicator.value`, `tiIndicator.type`, `tiIndicator.source`, `tiIndicator.malwareNames`, `tiIndicator.threatActors`, and `event.externalThreatValue`.

Threat Intelligence events are a parallel enrichment signal. They are not a literal SQL-style join between a DNS event and an IOC event. Validate endpoint, process, value, timeline, and Storyline context during investigation.

## NeverOff DNS analytic heuristics
These are **triage heuristics, not SentinelOne threat scores**.

- **NXDOMAIN / resolution-failure focus:** DNS response code `3` is treated as NXDOMAIN.
- **Long request candidate:** request length `>= 80`.
- **Very long request candidate:** request length `>= 120`.
- **Encoded-like label candidate:** long hexadecimal or Base32-like DNS labels.
- **Deep-label candidate:** six or more labels in a DNS name.
- **Burst candidate:** `>= 100` DNS events from the same endpoint/process in a 5-minute bucket.
- **High-unique-domain candidate:** `>= 50` distinct requested domains from the same endpoint/process in a 15-minute bucket.
- **High process DNS count:** `src.process.dnsCount >= 300`.
- **High-abuse TLD watchlist:** `.xyz, .top, .pw, .gq, .ga, .cf, .tk`.
- **Extended elevated-monitoring TLD set:** `.click, .work, .site, .online, .live, .icu, .buzz, .cam, .cyou, .monster, .quest, .sbs`.
- **Dual-use infrastructure:** Dynamic DNS, tunneling/relay services, public paste/CDN/file-transfer services, and encrypted-DNS resolver domains.

All thresholds should be tuned to the client's DNS architecture, recursive resolvers, VPN/proxy model, endpoint role, software inventory, and normal SaaS behavior.

## Important interpretation cautions
- DNS telemetry is **not packet inspection** and does not expose full application-layer payload semantics.
- Long or encoded-looking DNS names are common in legitimate CDN, tracking, EDR, identity, cloud, telemetry, and security products.
- Dynamic DNS, public tunnels, Discord/GitHub/CDN infrastructure, and DoH resolvers are legitimate technologies that are also abused by adversaries.
- A DNS lookup alone does not prove successful network communication or C2.
- High NXDOMAIN volume can come from stale software, search suffixes, typo correction, broken service discovery, ad/tracker blocking, or misconfiguration.
- Beacon-like panels show **repetition/concentration**, not mathematically proven periodicity.
- Use Storyline, process path, command line, user, response data, IP Connect, URL telemetry, and Threat Intelligence before escalation.

## MITRE ATT&CK alignment
Primary operational alignment:
- **T1071.004 — Application Layer Protocol: DNS**
- **T1568.002 — Dynamic Resolution: Domain Generation Algorithms**
- **T1041 — Exfiltration Over C2 Channel**
- **T1095 — Non-Application Layer Protocol** as contextual C2 hunting where DNS-adjacent tooling transitions to custom protocols.

## Recommended SOC workflow
**DNS Command Center → C2 & Abuse Infrastructure → NXDOMAIN → DGA & Domain Anomalies → DNS Tunneling → Threat Intelligence → Endpoint & Process → Investigation → Detection Engineering**


## V1.1 compatibility correction
Dashboard Event Search regular-expression comparisons use `matches`. V1.1 replaces the unsupported `regexp` token in regex-based dashboard panels with `matches`.

Developed by the Threat Detection Engineering Division at NeverOff Technology (SentinelOne Division)
Dominican Republic

graphs.title: DNS Events
graphs.description: Total DNS request/response telemetry in the selected time range.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns") | group DNS_Events = count()

graphs.title: Distinct Requested Domains
graphs.description: Estimated distinct DNS request values.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Domains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request)

graphs.title: Endpoints with DNS Activity
graphs.description: Protected endpoints producing DNS telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(endpoint.name)) | group Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name)

graphs.title: DNS Source Processes
graphs.description: Distinct processes associated with DNS telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(src.process.name)) | group Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name)

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Events
graphs.description: DNS events with response code 3.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group NXDOMAIN = count()

graphs.title: Non-Zero DNS Response Codes
graphs.description: DNS events whose response code is not zero.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode != 0) | group NonZeroResponses = count()

graphs.title: DNS Activity Over Time
graphs.description: Hourly DNS telemetry trend.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns") | group DNS_Events = count() by timestamp = timebucket('1 hour')

graphs.title: DNS Response Codes
graphs.description: Distribution of DNS response-code values.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns") | group DNS_Events = count() by event.dns.responseCode | sort -DNS_Events

graphs.title: DNS Transport Protocol
graphs.description: Observed DNS transport protocol values.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.transportProtocol)) | group DNS_Events = count() by event.dns.transportProtocol | sort -DNS_Events

graphs.title: DNS Protocol Values
graphs.description: Observed values of event.dns.protocol.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.protocol)) | group DNS_Events = count() by event.dns.protocol | sort -DNS_Events

graphs.title: DNS Telemetry Provider
graphs.description: Telemetry providers associated with DNS events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.provider)) | group DNS_Events = count() by event.dns.provider | sort -DNS_Events

graphs.title: Top Requested Domains
graphs.description: Most frequently requested DNS names.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Lookups = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by event.dns.request | sort -Lookups | limit 30

graphs.title: Top Endpoints by DNS Volume
graphs.description: Endpoints generating the greatest DNS volume.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(endpoint.name)) | group DNS_Events = count(), Domains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by endpoint.name, endpoint.os, site.name | sort -DNS_Events | limit 30

graphs.title: Top Processes by DNS Volume
graphs.description: Processes associated with the most DNS events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(src.process.name)) | group DNS_Events = count(), Domains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name) by src.process.name | sort -DNS_Events | limit 30

graphs.title: Endpoint → Process → Requested Domain
graphs.description: High-level DNS flow from endpoint to process to requested domain.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request))
| let Host = "Endpoint: " + endpoint.name
| let Proc = src.process.name != null ? "Process: " + src.process.name : "Process: Unattributed/System"
| let Domain = "DNS: " + event.dns.request
| group c = count() by Host, Proc, Domain
| sort -c
| limit 45
| let link = array(0,1).expand()
| let source = link == 0 ? Host : Proc
| let target = link == 0 ? Proc : Domain
| group c = sum(c) by source, target
| columns source, target, c

| filter(event.category == "dns" AND ((event.dns.request contains:anycase("duckdns.org","no-ip.com","no-ip.org","hopto.org","ddns.net","dynu.net","freedns.afraid.org","serveftp.com","servehttp.com","sytes.net","ngrok.io","ngrok.app","trycloudflare.com","loca.lt","serveo.net","localhost.run","bore.pub","pastebin.com","paste.ee","paste.rs","raw.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com","cdn.discordapp.com","discordapp.com","discord.com","transfer.sh","catbox.moe","gofile.io","dns.google","cloudflare-dns.com","mozilla.cloudflare-dns.com","dns.quad9.net","doh.opendns.com","dns.nextdns.io","adguard-dns.com")) OR event.dns.request contains:anycase(".onion")))
| let Category = event.dns.request contains:anycase("duckdns.org","no-ip.com","no-ip.org","hopto.org","ddns.net","dynu.net","freedns.afraid.org","serveftp.com","servehttp.com","sytes.net") ? "Dynamic DNS" : event.dns.request contains:anycase("ngrok.io","ngrok.app","trycloudflare.com","loca.lt","serveo.net","localhost.run","bore.pub") ? graphs.title: Endpoint / Process Attribution
graphs.description: Endpoints, processes and users generating monitored requests.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND ((event.dns.request contains:anycase("duckdns.org","no-ip.com","no-ip.org","hopto.org","ddns.net","dynu.net","freedns.afraid.org","serveftp.com","servehttp.com","sytes.net","ngrok.io","ngrok.app","trycloudflare.com","loca.lt","serveo.net","localhost.run","bore.pub","pastebin.com","paste.ee","paste.rs","raw.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com","cdn.discordapp.com","discordapp.com","discord.com","transfer.sh","catbox.moe","gofile.io","dns.google","cloudflare-dns.com","mozilla.cloudflare-dns.com","dns.quad9.net","doh.opendns.com","dns.nextdns.io","adguard-dns.com")) OR event.dns.request contains:anycase(".onion"))) | group Events = count(), Domains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by endpoint.name, site.name, src.process.name, src.process.user | sort -Events | limit 75

graphs.title: Category → Domain → Process → Endpoint
graphs.description: Investigation flow for monitored dual-use infrastructure.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.category == "dns" AND ((event.dns.request contains:anycase("duckdns.org","no-ip.com","no-ip.org","hopto.org","ddns.net","dynu.net","freedns.afraid.org","serveftp.com","servehttp.com","sytes.net","ngrok.io","ngrok.app","trycloudflare.com","loca.lt","serveo.net","localhost.run","bore.pub","pastebin.com","paste.ee","paste.rs","raw.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com","cdn.discordapp.com","discordapp.com","discord.com","transfer.sh","catbox.moe","gofile.io","dns.google","cloudflare-dns.com","mozilla.cloudflare-dns.com","dns.quad9.net","doh.opendns.com","dns.nextdns.io","adguard-dns.com")) OR event.dns.request contains:anycase(".onion")))
| let Category = event.dns.request contains:anycase("duckdns.org","no-ip.com","no-ip.org","hopto.org","ddns.net","dynu.net","freedns.afraid.org","serveftp.com","servehttp.com","sytes.net") ? "Dynamic DNS" : event.dns.request contains:anycase("ngrok.io","ngrok.app","trycloudflare.com","loca.lt","serveo.net","localhost.run","bore.pub") ? "Tunnel / Relay" : event.dns.request contains:anycase("pastebin.com","paste.ee","paste.rs","raw.githubusercontent.com","githubusercontent.com","cdn.discordapp.com","discordapp.com","discord.com","transfer.sh","catbox.moe","gofile.io") ? "Paste / CDN / Transfer" : event.dns.request contains:anycase("dns.google","cloudflare-dns.com","mozilla.cloudflare-dns.com","dns.quad9.net","doh.opendns.com","dns.nextdns.io","adguard-dns.com") ? | let Domain = "Domain: " + event.dns.request

| let Host = "Endpoint: " + endpoint.name

graphs.title: Raw Tunnel / Relay DNS Activity
graphs.description: Raw events for monitored tunnel / relay infrastructure.

graphs.title: Raw Encrypted Resolver Discovery
graphs.description: Raw DNS discovery of monitored encrypted resolver domains.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND (event.dns.request contains:anycase("dns.google","cloudflare-dns.com","mozilla.cloudflare-dns.com","dns.quad9.net","doh.opendns.com","dns.nextdns.io","adguard-dns.com"))) | columns event.time, site.name, endpoint.name, endpoint.os, src.process.user, src.process.name, src.process.cmdline, event.dns.request, event.dns.response, event.dns.responseCode | sort -event.time | limit 200

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Events
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group NXDOMAIN = count()

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Domains
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Domains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request)

graphs.title: Endpoints with NXDOMAIN
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(endpoint.name)) | group Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name)

graphs.title: Processes with NXDOMAIN
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(src.process.name)) | group Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name)

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Burst Buckets
graphs.description: 15-minute endpoint/process buckets with at least 20 NXDOMAIN events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group Failures = count() by timestamp = timebucket('15 minutes'), endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter Failures >= 20 | group BurstBuckets = count()

graphs.title: High-Unique Failed Domain Candidates
graphs.description: Endpoint/process pairs with broad failed-domain diversity.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Failures = count(), UniqueFailedDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter Failures >= 30 AND UniqueFailedDomains >= 20 | group Candidates = count()

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Activity Over Time
graphs.description: NXDOMAIN trend over the selected period.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group NXDOMAIN = count() by timestamp = timebucket('1 hour')

graphs.title: Top NXDOMAIN Requests
graphs.description: Failed domains ranked by NXDOMAIN volume.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Failures = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by event.dns.request | sort -Failures | limit 50

graphs.title: Top Endpoint / Process NXDOMAIN Sources
graphs.description: Endpoint/process pairs producing NXDOMAIN activity.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group Failures = count(), UniqueFailedDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by endpoint.name, site.name, src.process.name, src.process.user | sort -Failures | limit 75

graphs.title: NXDOMAIN Burst Candidates — 15 Minute
graphs.description: NeverOff heuristic: >=20 NXDOMAIN events in one 15-minute endpoint/process bucket.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3) | group Failures = count(), UniqueDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by timestamp = timebucket('15 minutes'), endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter Failures >= 20 | sort -Failures | limit 100

graphs.title: Broad NXDOMAIN / DGA-Like Candidates
graphs.description: High failed-domain diversity may indicate DGA activity, stale software, ad blocking or misconfiguration.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Failures = count(), UniqueFailedDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter Failures >= 30 AND UniqueFailedDomains >= 20 | sort -UniqueFailedDomains | limit 100

graphs.title: Endpoint → Process → NXDOMAIN Request
graphs.description: NXDOMAIN attribution flow.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request))
| let Host = "Endpoint: " + endpoint.name
| let Proc = src.process.name != null ? "Process: " + src.process.name : "Process: Unattributed/System"
| let Domain = "NXDOMAIN: " + event.dns.request
| group c = count() by Host, Proc, Domain
| sort -c
| limit 45
| let link = array(0,1).expand()
| let source = link == 0 ? Host : Proc
| let target = link == 0 ? Proc : Domain
| group c = sum(c) by source, target
| columns source, target, c

graphs.title: High-Abuse TLD Watchlist Events
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk"))) | group Events = count()

graphs.title: Extended TLD Monitoring Events
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs"))) | group Events = count()

graphs.title: Long DNS Requests ≥80
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | let RequestLength = len(event.dns.request) | filter RequestLength >= 80 | group Events = count()

graphs.title: Very Long DNS Requests ≥120
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | let RequestLength = len(event.dns.request) | filter RequestLength >= 120 | group Events = count()

graphs.title: Encoded-Like Label Candidates
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request) AND event.dns.request matches ".*([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|[A-Za-z2-7]{40,})\..*") | group Events = count()

graphs.title: Deep-Label Candidates
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request) AND event.dns.request matches "^([^.]+\.){5,}[^.]+$") | group Events = count()

graphs.title: DNS Anomaly Categories Over Time
graphs.description: Trend of NeverOff DNS anomaly heuristics.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request))
| let RequestLength = len(event.dns.request)
| filter(RequestLength >= 80 OR event.dns.request matches ".*([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|[A-Za-z2-7]{40,})\..*" OR event.dns.request matches "^([^.]+\.){5,}[^.]+$" OR (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")) OR (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs")))
| let Anomaly = event.dns.request matches ".*([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|[A-Za-z2-7]{40,})\..*" ? "Encoded-Like Label" : event.dns.request matches ".*[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\.(xyz|top|pw|click|work|site|online|live|icu|buzz|cam|cyou|monster|quest|sbs)$" ? "Long Alphanumeric + Watched TLD" : event.dns.request matches "^([^.]+\.){5,}[^.]+$" ? "Deep Label Chain" : len(event.dns.request) >= 120 ? "Very Long Request" : (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")) ? "High-Abuse TLD Watchlist" : (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs")) ? "Extended TLD Watchlist" : "Other"
| group Events = count() by timestamp = timebucket('1 hour'), Anomaly
| transpose Anomaly on timestamp

graphs.title: Anomaly Type → Domain → Process → Endpoint
graphs.description: Visual investigation of domain-anomaly heuristics.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request))
| let RequestLength = len(event.dns.request)
| filter(RequestLength >= 80 OR event.dns.request matches ".*([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|[A-Za-z2-7]{40,})\..*" OR event.dns.request matches "^([^.]+\.){5,}[^.]+$" OR (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")) OR (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs")))
| let Anomaly = event.dns.request matches ".*([A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|[A-Za-z2-7]{40,})\..*" ? "Encoded-Like Label" : event.dns.request matches ".*[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\.(xyz|top|pw|click|work|site|online|live|icu|buzz|cam|cyou|monster|quest|sbs)$" ? "Long Alphanumeric + Watched TLD" : event.dns.request matches "^([^.]+\.){5,}[^.]+$" ? "Deep Label Chain" : len(event.dns.request) >= 120 ? "Very Long Request" : (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")) ? "High-Abuse TLD Watchlist" : (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs")) ? "Extended TLD Watchlist" : "Other"
| let Domain = "Domain: " + event.dns.request
| let Proc = src.process.name != null ? "Process: " + src.process.name : "Process: Unattributed/System"

| let target = link == 0 ? Domain : link == 1 ? Proc : Host

graphs.title: Detection Engineering Guidance
graphs.markdown:
# Detection Engineering Guidance

Use this tab to validate stable patterns before converting them into **STAR Custom Rules, correlation rules, or SOC playbooks**.

## High-signal single-event candidates
These can be evaluated at the event level after tuning:

**Monitored TLD**
`event.category = "dns" AND event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")`

**Very long DNS request**
`event.category = "dns" AND len(event.dns.request) >= 120`

**Encoded-like DNS label**
Use the dashboard's encoded-label regular expression after validating false positives in the tenant.

**Monitored tunnel / relay infrastructure**
Use the embedded tunnel/relay domain list only when the client policy makes those services unauthorized or when additional suspicious context is present.

## Correlation / aggregation candidates
These should not be converted blindly into single-event STAR rules:

- `>=100` DNS events by endpoint + process in 5 minutes.
- `>=50` unique requested domains by endpoint + process in 15 minutes.
- High NXDOMAIN diversity from one endpoint/process.
- Repeated lookups to one domain from the same process across multiple time buckets.
- Long/encoded DNS requests plus suspicious process context.
- DNS anomaly + IP Connect to newly observed infrastructure.
- DNS anomaly + Threat Intelligence IOC hit on the same endpoint/process/time window.

## Recommended response posture
Start with **Alert Only**. After validation, use process termination or Network Quarantine only when the complete Storyline and incident context justify containment.

## Tuning priorities
Exclude or baseline:
- EDR/security products.
- browsers and enterprise updaters where appropriate.
- DNS resolver services.
- cloud/identity agents.
- VPN/ZTNA clients.
- telemetry and observability agents.
- approved Dynamic DNS / tunnel services.
- authorized developer tooling.

The objective is high signal-to-noise, not maximum event volume.

graphs.title: Candidate Rule — Very Long DNS Requests
graphs.description: Baseline very-long-request candidates before alerting.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | let RequestLength = len(event.dns.request) | filter RequestLength >= 120 | group Events = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by event.dns.request, RequestLength | sort -Events | limit 100

graphs.description: Baseline policy-defined TLD monitoring before alerting.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND ((event.dns.request contains:anycase(".xyz",".top",".pw",".gq",".ga",".cf",".tk")) OR (event.dns.request contains:anycase(".click",".work",".site",".online",".live",".icu",".buzz",".cam",".cyou",".monster",".quest",".sbs")))) | group Events = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by event.dns.request | sort -Events | limit 100

graphs.title: Candidate Correlation — DNS Burst
graphs.description: Aggregation candidate for correlation-rule design.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns") | group DNS_Events = count(), UniqueDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by timestamp = timebucket('5 minutes'), endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter DNS_Events >= 100 | sort -DNS_Events | limit 100

graphs.title: Candidate Correlation — NXDOMAIN Diversity
graphs.description: DGA-oriented aggregation candidate; validate stale software and blocking infrastructure first.
graphs.query: | filter(event.category == "dns" AND event.dns.responseCode == 3 AND !isempty(event.dns.request)) | group Failures = count(), UniqueFailedDomains = estimate_distinct(event.dns.request) by endpoint.name, src.process.name | filter Failures >= 30 AND UniqueFailedDomains >= 20 | sort -UniqueFailedDomains | limit 100
